name: Proreta
line: A private command center for your texts, email and calendar.
description: Proreta is a private command center for your texts, email and calendar that runs on your own computers at home.
about: Proreta brings your texts, email and calendar into one place, so nothing that needs an answer slips by. It's built for privacy-minded people, including anyone thinking about running local AI on their email.

image.alt: Proreta's command center: everyone you talk to in a list on the left, a text conversation in the middle, and that person's settings, notes and to-dos on the right.
image.caption: The command center prototype, shown with made-up people and messages.

items.title: iMessage too
items.text: A helper on your own Mac brings in your iMessage and SMS threads, right next to your email. Email-only assistants never see them.

items.title: One place, by person
items.text: Texts, email and calendar in one place, organized around the people in your life instead of by app.

items.title: Contacts that connect
items.text: Each person's phone numbers and email addresses are matched, so everything from them lands on one page.

items.title: Knows who's who
items.text: People are grouped as family, close friends, friends or professional, suggested from your texts and confirmed by you. Businesses get their own tab.

items.title: Remembers the details
items.text: Notes, to-dos and facts for each person. Facts it picks up from your texts wait for your OK.

items.title: Help, person by person
items.text: For each person, choose Watch, Remind or Draft: from keeping track, to reminders, to replies drafted for your review.

items.title: Kept at home
items.text: What it reads is kept on your own computers. Money and health content is handled only by a local AI model, and you choose what, if anything, a cloud AI may read.

items.title: Read-only access
items.text: It reads Gmail and Google Calendar with Google's read-only access, so it can't send, change or delete mail or events.

items.title: Hardware key
items.text: Opening it, and raising anyone's AI access, need a touch of your YubiKey.

items.title: Off the internet
items.text: It has no public address. It's reachable only at home or over a VPN, and always over HTTPS.

items.title: Network isolation
items.text: It runs on its own walled-off part of your home network.

items.title: Emergency stop
items.text: One STOP switch pauses everything at once.

sections.heading: Status
paragraphs: The current prototype is intended for the developer's own accounts, and no one else signs in to it. Later, Proreta may be offered as a package with guided instructions, so you can install your own copy at home.

privacy.intro: This policy covers Proreta, a private command center that reads its owner's own messages, email and calendar. Only its owner signs in to it, with the owner's own accounts.
collects: Email: with the read-only Gmail access that the owner grants at Google's sign-in, it reads the messages in the owner's own Gmail accounts, with their headers and labels.
Calendar: with read-only Google Calendar access granted the same way, it reads the events on the owner's own calendars, such as their times, titles, places and guests.
Texts and contacts: on the owner's own computers, it reads the owner's own text messages and contacts.
It can't send, change or delete mail or calendar events, and it reads nothing else in the Google account.
privacy.uses: Only to help the owner keep up with the owner's own messages, email and calendar, for example by showing them in one place, sorting them and noting what needs an answer.
privacy.shares: It's never sold, used for ads or used to train AI models. What it reads is kept on the owner's own devices. The owner may let an AI assistant read some of it, only to help with the owner's own messages.
privacy.keeps: For as long as the owner keeps it on those devices. Removing Proreta's access in the Google account stops all further reading of email and calendar.
privacy.choices: The owner can remove its access at any time, under [Third-party apps and services](https://myaccount.google.com/connections) in the Google account.

extra.heading: Google user data
paragraphs: Proreta's use and transfer of information received from Google APIs adheres to the [Google API Services User Data Policy](https://developers.google.com/terms/api-services-user-data-policy), including the Limited Use requirements.
Proreta is a private tool for its owner's own use. It isn't offered, sold or licensed to anyone else, and no one else may sign in to it.

sections.heading: As is
paragraphs: It's provided as is, with no promise that it works or stays available.
